def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    closing_prices = [150, 152, 155, 151, 154, 156, 157, 158, 160, 162, 161, 159]
    lookback_period = 5
    window = closing_prices[-lookback_period:]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    rank = sorted(window).index(window[-1]) + 1
    worden_stochastic = (100 / (lookback_period - 1)) * (rank - 1)

    # Return the answer as a percentage rounded to two decimal places
    return f"{worden_stochastic:.2f}%"
